title: Busy onboarding or community lock skips onboarding with no log
current: A busy onboarding lock or community-wide lock returns not_due and prints nothing.
evidence: Both branches return { status: 'not_due' } without logDiagnostic. Under the cron rule this is a silent repeating skip. Related to R-S7-01.
required: An info skip line with a reason and the lock holder's workflow (via the #237 lock timing).
investigate: How often does onboarding get starved by lock contention?

criticality.why: Onboarding starvation would be invisible, though it self-recovers when the lock frees.
